text: Blessing - knee op Thurs 14/11 @ 8am, St Thomas'. remind me to text her the night before
Chris + Kiara - engaged!! wedding prob next summer, she wants Portugal
Theo's mum in hosp since Sat, fall / hip. he's v stressed, juggling work. check in w him Fri evening
dentist Tues at half 4. pick up prescription on way back
Björn (Bjö) back from Stockholm 3rd of June. wants to do dinner the wk after
Malik - hernia op went fine yday, home already. ask how recovery going next wk
Reza nervous re MRI tomorrow morning, 9.15 @ Royal Free. text him good luck first thing
Lucy's dad - bypass surgery 22 Jan. she's taking 2 wks off to look after him. don't forget to send her something the day after
Santiago / Santi - started at Deloitte Mon. hates the commute already lol
Pooja + husband moving to Leeds end of March. her bro Anil helping w van
Sara - dog Biscuit had op on his leg, vet says 6 wks crate rest. poor thing. ask after him Sat
Anan's driving test 28/02 at 10am. he's failed twice, really anxious. remind me to text him the morning of
Salma's bday 9th of Aug - mentioned she wants a decent chef's knife. note for later

call w Demi. her nan passed last Weds, v sudden - was fine at Sunday lunch. funeral Mon 2pm @ Golders Green, wake after at her aunt's. Demi doing the eulogy, dreading it, hasn't written a word. her mum not coping well either. must send flowers the day before + text Demi that evening. offer to read over the eulogy if she wants
Matilda - 2nd round interview @ Google Weds 11am. remind me to ask how it went that evening
Florin - gluten free, also no nuts. for bbq Sat
Yasmin + Natasha - housewarming cancelled, flat fell through. Yasmin gutted. Nat looking elsewhere
Erin - cataract op on 5 May, other eye in July. her son driving her. ring her the day after the first one
Mai - newborn! girl, Hana, born 2 Oct, 7lb 3. Mai exhausted but happy. sort a gift + card this wk

Uma's partner Pieter has back surgery Fri at 1pm - disc thing, been in agony since summer. she's nervous, kids off school that wk too so she's juggling. her mum coming down Thurs to help. remind me to message Uma that evening to see how he got on, and offer to take the kids Sat morning
Jess - grad ceremony 18 July @ 2. her parents flying in from Cape Town the day before
Ryan - knee still bad after the match. physio Mon morning. I'm giving him a lift
Tariq says his sister Sofia got into Edinburgh med school!! starts Sept
Afua - colonoscopy on the 12th at half 9. prep day before = grim. she's anxious. text her the night before + ask how it went after

Esther - retiring end of Dec after 30 yrs at the council. party 19/12 @ the Crown, 7pm, partners welcome. she wants to do the Camino in spring, been talking about it for yrs. chip in for leaving present - need to ask Chris who's collecting. walking poles?? or a decent rucksack
bins Weds. MOT due 14/05 - book garage this wk, prob Sat morning

Blessing home from hosp Sunday after the knee op. stitches out 28/11. her brother Adebayo staying w her for a wk, then their mum takes over. she's bored already, can't drive for 6 wks. drop round w soup Tues evening + bring that box set she wanted

Kiara - Chris's mum has Alzheimer's, getting worse. they're looking at care homes, visiting 2 next Sat morning. Kiara v tired, doing most of the admin. she said Chris won't talk about it. his brother lives in Dubai, no help
Theo - running Brighton half 13 April. training going ok, calf niggle. wish him luck the night before
Lucy - new cat, Pickle. rescue, v shy
remind me to ask Malik how his dad's scan went - was Thurs at 3pm
Pooja's dad 70 on 1st of Sept. surprise lunch planned, she's sorting. Anil doing cake. Pooja asked me to keep the date free
Reza results - all clear!! had been worrying for wks. send congrats + maybe a bottle
Sara - prob going part time from Jan to care for her mum after mum's stroke. she's ok-ish. her mum has physio 3x a wk now
Santi + Demi - anniversary 2 Nov, 5 yrs. going to Lisbon for long wknd

Natasha Okafor - hysterectomy 7 Feb, 6-8 wks recovery. her wife Esther taking time off. Nat being v matter of fact but Esther says she's scared. remind me to send a card the wk before and call Nat the wk after, not before (she'd hate the fuss)
Anan PASSED his driving test. finally, 3rd time lucky. wants to take us all out for a drive lol
Florin - promoted to head of ops! starts new role 1 Dec. buy him a drink Fri
vet for Rolo Thurs 10am - booster. then Tesco
Mai's husband Ryan Tanaka back at work Mon after paternity. she's dreading days alone w baby. check in on her Mon afternoon
Erin's op postponed - surgeon off sick. rebooked for 20/05 at 8.30. her son Matt annoyed, already booked leave
Yasmin - started a pottery course Tues nights. loves it. wants a wheel eventually - gift idea?
Uma - Pieter home from hosp. walking w frame. she says he's grumpy but ok. I'm doing their shopping Sat
Adebayo - stag do in Kraków 23-26 Oct. he's best man for his cousin. back Sun night

Jess and her bf Theo split up - his call apparently, out of nowhere. she's moving back to her mum's on 30th, mum's place in Croydon. she's pretty low, not eating much. Theo keeping the flat. don't forget to invite her for dinner the wknd after the move
Tariq - wisdom teeth out tmrw at 2pm, gen anaesthetic. v nervous of needles. remind me to text him tomorrow evening + again Sat
Matilda got the Google job!!! starts 6 Jan. she's moving to London Dec

chat w Afua: her twins start reception in Sept, both @ St Mary's. her mum's moving in to help. Afua's back at work 3 days. her husband away w work most of Oct. she sounded frazzled, said she's not sleeping. offer to have the twins one Sat
Esther - hip replacement 4/03 @ 7.30am. Natasha taking her in. Esther worried about anaesthetic, had bad reaction b4. I should ring her the night before + pop round wk after with flowers
Chris - leaving drinks Fri from 6 @ the Anchor. he's off to Bristol job
Kiara's sister Blessing Mensah - due in March, 1st baby. Kiara going to be an auntie, buzzing
Theo's knee op cancelled again, NHS backlog. no new date. he's fed up
Lucy Morris - PhD viva 15 Nov, 10am. v nervous. her supervisor says she'll be fine. remind me to send good luck msg the evening before and ask how it went the day after
Salma - allergic to penicillin, found out the hard way last wk. rash all over. better now
Björn's son Anil - 1st day at secondary Weds. Björn more nervous than him. ask Björn how it went Weds evening
Demi - interview for the head of year role Mon 3pm. prep together Sun morning? she asked

Santiago - mum's chemo starts 10/11, every 3 wks for 6 cycles. he's flying to Bogotá on the 8th to be with her, back early Dec. his sister Sofia staying longer. he's trying to work remotely from there but worried. need to message him the day after first session, then maybe every couple of wks. also cover his 5 a side spot
Pieter - 50 on 2 Feb. Uma says he wants a proper coffee grinder, Baratza or similar
Sofia Lopez - eye test Friday at 4. new glasses prob
Malik + wife Pooja - IVF round 2 starts next month. they're hopeful but bruised after last time. don't mention unless they do
